warnings: Every point on this sheet is printed as a combined footing/column marker, e.g. 'F1/C1' = footing type F1 with column type C1 on top. Recorded as two separate merged entries (one footing, one column) sharing the same grid_refs, per §0.1's rule that footing and column are distinct element_types with distinct specs — not a single 'F1/C1' element_id.

Footing counts cross-checked against the sheet's own footnote: 'F1 = 6 หลุม = 6 ต้น, F2 = 2 หลุม = 4 ต้น (2 ต้นต่อหลุม), F1A = 6 หลุม = 6 ต้น' — 6+2+6=14 marked positions on the plan, which matches exactly (F1 x6, F1A x6, F2 x2). No footing is printed at row E, column 1 (the building footprint is notched there) and none at row B' (see grid master note on 'CA').

Row B' (between B and C) carries a column (CA) on the beam plans (หน้า18/19) but has no footing on this sheet — the sheet's own dimension chain skips straight from B to C as a single 4.00 m span, confirming B' is beam-supported only, not a separate footing line.
